subject.title: fix(imessage): apply authoritative projection in anchorless recovery

question: Should an iMessage area owner supply exact-head live `imsg rpc` proof for corrected routing and outgoing-row suppression before this PR merges?
rationale: The implementation and source-level regression coverage are convincing, but the contributor cannot access a compatible signed-in Mac with Full Disk Access and the new fail-closed delivery behavior cannot be cleared by mocks or CI alone.

options.title: Require owner-supplied live proof
options.body: An iMessage-capable owner runs both recovery scenarios on head 577af515 and posts redacted terminal or gateway evidence before merge.

options.title: Hold for contributor-accessible proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until the contributor or another reviewer obtains a compatible macOS bridge environment.
